📢 *WE’RE HIRING! | Join the MeWeSports Team!* 🏀⚽

Are you passionate about sports, working with young people, and making a difference in adolescent mental health and wellbeing?

MeWeSports, a sports-based programme by Sangath, uses the power of play to help adolescents build life skills, strengthen their wellbeing, and make informed choices.

We are looking for 2 enthusiastic MeWeSports Facilitators to join our team and bring learning to life, both on and off the field!

📍 Location: North Goa
🎓 Eligibility: Minimum 12th pass, below 35 years of age
🗣️ Languages: Spoken Marathi, Hindi and Konkani
🏃 Ideal for: Individuals interested in sports, youth wellbeing, education, social work and community engagement.

📩 Interested? Scan the QR code on the poster to learn more and apply!

📧 Queries: argcareers@sangath.in

✨ Come play, connect, and make an impact!

Know someone who would be a great fit? Share this opportunity with them!

Application are invited for the above mentioned post.

🌱 A career opportunity rooted in agriculture!

Goa College of Agriculture, Ela Farm, Old Goa, invites applications for the position of Lab – Field Assistant on a contractual basis for 11 months.

💼 Monthly Remuneration: ₹20,000 (Consolidated)\
🎓 Qualification: B.Sc. in Agriculture\
🔬 Preferred Experience: Work related to biofertilizers and biopesticides production and utilisation.

📌 How to Apply?\
Eligible candidates must submit their applications along with self-attested/certified copies of mark sheets from SSC onwards.

📍 Applications should reach the Principal, Goa College of Agriculture, Ela Farm, Old Goa, within 8 days from the date of advertisement (30 October 2026).

📝 Application format is available on the official website of Goa College of Agriculture.

For those passionate about agriculture, this could be an opportunity to turn knowledge into practical experience.
